name: f2ip_conv
desc: F2IP.S8.F32 float->int8 pack-pair convert (sm90). ptxas's fused lowering of the CUTLASS NumericArrayConverter<int8_t,float> epilogue (cvt.rni.s32.f32 + cvt.pack.sat.s8.s32.b32) that quantizes fp32 accumulators to packed int8 before the global store — the 13_fused_two_gemms_s8 examples emit 176 of these after the IMMA.16832 mainloop. Kernel packs 4 floats per word (byte j = sat_s8(round_nearest_even(in[i*4+j]))) via two F2IP calls; host oracle is bit-exact.
